metadata.description: Official Octoparse agent skills — agent-driven web data collection

plugins.name: octoparse
plugins.description: Octoparse's web data collection capability, driven by an agent through the Octoparse MCP server. Reaches data through preset cloud templates, managed typed datasets, and — as it ships — agent-generated tasks for the long tail. Covers lead generation and contact enrichment, e-commerce price monitoring and product research, review and reputation analysis, company and supplier research, job and talent-market research, property and travel listings, social listening, and search-result capture — across Google Maps, Amazon, Temu, TikTok Shop, LinkedIn, Indeed, Yellow Pages, Gelbe Seiten, Pagesjaunes, Naver, Suumo, Booking, and hundreds more sites in English, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Korean.
